## Objective
- Build a complete, playable original first-person shooter with fast-paced arcade gameplay.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; the user authorized using code from an open-source Black Ops 2 project.
- Keep the engine, assets, and audio original; avoid implying Activision affiliation.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js for an FPS with a Nuketown-inspired map, class loadouts, team deathmatch, scorestreaks, and HUD.
- Identify the game as unaffiliated with Activision.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the menu, loadouts, HUD, pause/end screens, and Three.js entry point in `index.html`.
- Implemented procedural audio in `src/audio.js` and vendored Three.js at `vendor/three.module.js`.
- Implemented world construction, gameplay systems, minimap, scoreboard, UI/input handlers, and render loop in `src/main.js`.

2. Re-test gameplay and UI after fixing any runtime issue; refresh the screenshot if needed.

- `src/main.js`: Main game implementation and suspected timer/runtime issue.
- `index.html`: UI shell and Three.js import map.
- `src/audio.js`: Procedural audio engine.
- `screenshots/blackout-gameplay.jpg`: Latest captured gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `index.html` is modified; `src/` and `vendor/` are untracked.
- Browser checks launched the game and acquired pointer lock without reporting page errors, but the timer was observed staying at `6:00`.
